title: Preadditive category
statement: A *preadditive category* is a category $\mathcal C$ together with an abelian group structure on every set $\mathrm{Hom}(X,Y)$ such that composition is bilinear: $(g+g')\circ f=g\circ f+g'\circ f$ and $g\circ(f+f')=g\circ f+g\circ f'$. In particular $1-u:=\mathrm{id}_X-u$ is defined for every endomorphism $u$ of $X$.
